summary: The root كفي (kfy) primarily means to suffice or be sufficient. It conveys the idea of something being enough or adequate for a purpose, fulfilling a need, or being sufficient for someone.

headwords.def: كَفَى He, or it, sufficed, or contented: hence كَفَانِى فُلَانٌ الأَمْرَ Such a one sufficed me, or contented me, in respect of the affair; i. e., by taking upon himself to perform it or accomplish it if good, or to prevent it or avert it if evil: and كَفَانِى شَهِيدًا He sufficed me as, or for, a witness; or he suffices me as, or for, such: and sometimes بِ is redundantly prefixed to its agent, and sometimes to its objective complement; as in exs. cited in art. ب . See Ham, p. 152. كَفَى [ It sufficed, or satisfied, or contented, ] it stood instead of another thing, or other things; (Msb;) [as also كَفَى عَنْ غَيْرِهِ .] كَفَى بِنَا for كَفَانَا &c. See W, pp. 5 and 6 كَفَى , aor. يَكْفِى , inf. n. كِفَايَةٌ , also signifies دَفَعَ and مَنَعَ

headwords.gloss: He was; became, sufficed; so as to need nothing more

parts.t: so as to need nothing more;

headwords.def: اِكْتَفَى بِالشَّىْءِ He was, or became, sufficed by the thing, so as to need nothing more; or content with it. (Msb.)

headwords.def: كِفَايَةٌ A sufficiency; enough; a thing that suffices, or contents, and enables one to obtain what one seeks. (TA, art. بلغ .) قَامَ بِكِفَايَتِهِ He undertook his maintenance; he maintained him; syn. مَانَهُ . (S, K, art. مون .)
